changes.name: Yūgao Uzuki
changes.supporting_evidence: The only manga-supported capability is basic medical assistance. Kenjutsu competence is explicitly unknown in the manga; other material is anime-only.
changes.calibration_justification: Zaji (Power 1 support specialist) and non-combatant anchors support Power 1 for a support-only character with no demonstrated combat effectiveness.
changes.reason: Power 2 was the adaptation ceiling, not demonstrated combat capability.

changes.name: Yūgao Uzuki
changes.supporting_evidence: No manga-demonstrated offensive technique or result is supplied.
changes.calibration_justification: Attacker Fit requires direct offensive effectiveness; comparison with Hinata and Ino anchors keeps zero where offense is not demonstrated.
changes.reason: Anime-only kenjutsu expansion cannot support Attacker Fit under the policy.

changes.name: Yūgao Uzuki

changes.calibration_justification: Kakashi and Torune anchors require concrete stealth or infiltration actions.

changes.name: Yūgao Uzuki
changes.supporting_evidence: No demonstrated planning or tactical decision is supplied.
changes.calibration_justification: Shikamaru/Shikaku anchors require demonstrated tactical action.

changes.name: Mitate
changes.supporting_evidence: Manga-supplied evidence shows medical diagnosis only. First-aid deployment and memory-restoration genjutsu are anime-only and excluded by NARUTO-CANON-0.1.
changes.calibration_justification: Healer Fit requires demonstrated treatment of others, not diagnosis alone; Shizune and Sakura are treatment anchors.
changes.reason: Apply the canonical policy to anime-only healing evidence.

changes.name: Oyone
changes.supporting_evidence: Supplied evidence is medical analysis of Pain's Animal Path; the page infers knowledge and chakra control but shows no treatment of a patient.
changes.calibration_justification: Karin (Healer 3) and Shizune (Healer 4) are treatment anchors; analysis alone does not meet Healer 1.
changes.reason: An inferred medical role is not a demonstrated ability to treat others.

changes.name: Kumadori
changes.supporting_evidence: Supplied evidence is medical analysis of Pain's Animal Path with no treatment technique or combat feat shown.
changes.calibration_justification: Karin (Healer 3) and Shizune (Healer 4) require actual healing actions; inference-only medical knowledge does not qualify.
changes.reason: Remove an inferred Healer Fit that lacks a demonstrated treatment action.
